tools.name: browser_status
tools.description: Check the shared browser connection without opening Chrome or showing prompts.

tools.name: browser_pages
tools.description: Find your current working pages after a conversation resumes. Recover an orphaned human handoff with browser_resume; with guardrails full, only after explicit owner confirmation.

tools.name: browser_connect
tools.description: Wait up to 10 s for the phantab bridge extension in the configured everyday Chrome profile and report the connection. Never shows a prompt; other tools wait for the bridge themselves, so this is not a required first step. profile asks about another Chrome profile the owner allowed, by its name or folder; a closed one starts without a window first, which can take up to 15 s.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open an independent invisible page sharing the owner Chrome login by default. visible explicitly opens a normal owner tab. isolated-headless has separate login. Does not control existing tabs. With snapshot true, the result ends with the new page's snapshot, as browser_snapshot shows it, so opening a page and reading it is one call. profile opens it in another Chrome profile the owner allowed, by its name or folder (default: the everyday one); a closed one starts without a window.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List available existing website tabs with stable IDs; no focus changes. Use only when the task needs an existing owner tab. profile lists another allowed Chrome profile's tabs.

tools.name: browser_attach
tools.description: Attach to the exact existing tab requested by the owner. Never choose merely by matching a domain when multiple tabs exist. profile names the allowed Chrome profile the tab is in.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Read a page: its text and the controls a person could use, through open shadow roots and website frames. The result is one JSON line of page fields, then a line per control after CONTROLS: x,y for the click_xy action, tag#id, name=, type=, its text in quotes, a link's href (only its #part when it goes to a place on this page), then flags; offscreen means scroll to it first. Controls marked fN (frame N of the FRAMES line) or shadow take click_xy and press, because selectors reach the main document only. The page text comes last, after TEXT:. framesUnread above 0 means some frames did not answer in time, so read again. framesSkipped and elementsOmitted count what the size limits left out. Typed values in input fields are not read, but a ticked box or radio shows checked and a select its chosen option as selected=; text the page displays is read, including editable areas. A repeat snapshot of a page shows only the controls and text lines changed since your last one, when that is shorter, and every result leaves out page fields unchanged since your last one for that page; full true shows everything. Leave pageId out for the page your last call named.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the assigned page for visual inspection. Leave pageId out for the page your last call named.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a CSS selector or visible text in the assigned page without stealing focus; or, with only seconds (up to 60), just pause. With verification true, wait instead for the page's verification check to reach the owner or end (up to seconds, at most 60): its verification.state says how, and its next says what to do; while the owner has it, verification.wake is a command to start in the background before you end your turn, which exits once the check ends. Leave pageId out for the page your last call named.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.description: Interact with your assigned page. steps lists the actions to do, in order, each a list: ["click", selector], ["fill", selector, text], ["select", selector, value or label], ["press", key], ["scroll", deltaY], ["click_xy", x, y] or ["navigate", url]. The first that fails stops the rest and says which, and the result ends with the page's snapshot after them, or after the failure, as browser_snapshot shows it (snapshot false leaves it out), so a run of steps and its check is one call. action with its fields is the older form of one step, and then of the ones after it (each with this tool's fields but pageId); with them the snapshot comes only with snapshot true. Agent writes are blocked during owner takeover; site changes are reserved against other agents. With guardrails light or full, a click or press that reads as a payment or checkout, a password or two-factor change, or deleting an account or vault items is refused until you repeat it with ownerConfirmed true, set only after the owner explicitly approves that step; it covers the first step. Leave pageId out for the page your last call named.

tools.name: browser_show
tools.description: Show the exact working page to the owner and pause agent writes. Shared workspaces reveal the actual Chrome window with unsaved state intact; isolated headless pages use a local interactive view. With verification true, hand the owner the page's verification check (one reported as state widget); Phantab takes the page back by itself once it clears, and the result's verification.wake, started in the background before you end your turn, exits then so your harness wakes you.

tools.name: browser_resume
tools.description: Resume after owner handback. For live views the owner clicks Return to agent; for ordinary visible tabs set ownerConfirmed after explicit user handback. With guardrails full, resume waits for one of those. A shared page goes back to its fixed hidden size, so coordinates read during the takeover no longer apply.

tools.name: browser_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in to the site on this page with its saved login, with no secret ever shown to you. Sign-in only: refuses sign-up and paying forms. Returns a status and never a secret; call again per step (next-step). Never claims signed-in: snapshot to see where it landed. account picks one saved login by its exact name when status is ambiguous. Statuses: README.md of phantab.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close only agent-created pages; detach from owner tabs without closing them. Refuses while owner takeover is active.
